query:
-- Inserir prazos globais únicos (sem duplicação)
INSERT IGNORE INTO deliveryOptions (name, daysToDeliver, pricePerM2, isActive, `order`)
SELECT DISTINCT name, daysToDeliver, pricePerM2, isActive, `order`
FROM productDeliveryOptions
ORDER BY `order`, name;

-- Vincular produtos aos prazos globais
INSERT INTO productDeliveryOptionMappings (productId, deliveryOptionId)
SELECT DISTINCT pdo.productId, do.id
FROM productDeliveryOptions pdo
JOIN deliveryOptions do ON pdo.name = do.name 
  AND pdo.daysToDeliver = do.daysToDeliver 
  AND pdo.pricePerM2 = do.pricePerM2;
